card.name: Start of 'concomitant' and 'concurrent'
card.fires_on: The first piece of the word concomitant (or concurrent), when it opens a sentence or clause about drug interactions. The word usually follows a colon, dash, period or opening bracket.

modes.label: Sentence-opening Concomitant
modes.description: Con at the start of a sentence in a drug interaction entry, after a heading, colon, dash or period.
